description: This file defines the AuditTrail class used for tracking user operations within the vtiger CRM system, including methods for retrieving audit trail headers and entries.

classes.name: AuditTrail
classes.description: Class for tracking user operations and retrieving audit trail data in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: AuditTrail
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger and database connection.

methods.name: getAuditTrailHeader
methods.description: Returns headers for audit trail display: Module, Action, Record ID, Action Date.

methods.name: getAuditTrailEntries
methods.description: Retrieves audit trail entries for a specific user with pagination and sorting options.
